modules.title: Supply Chain Management
modules.description: Supply chain fundamentals and end-to-end coordination

topics.title: What is Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)?
topics.summary: Understand what S&OP is, why companies need it, what business problems it solves, and how it connects departments.

topics.title: Purpose and Benefits of Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)
topics.summary: Understand why companies implement S&OP, the business problems it addresses, its operational and financial benefits, and how it supports cross-functional decisions.

topics.title: Understanding Demand and Supply
topics.summary: Understand demand and supply in business and manufacturing, distinguish customer needs, orders, actual sales and forecasted demand, assess supply capability and constraints, and analyze demand-supply gaps in S&OP.

topics.title: Departments Involved in Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)
topics.summary: Understand why S&OP requires cross-functional collaboration, the responsibilities and information contributions of Sales, Demand Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Supply Planning, Inventory, Finance, Product Management and Executive Leadership, how departments interact, how S&OP resolves conflicts, and how an S&OP Analyst supports aligned business decisions.

topics.title: S&OP vs. Other Planning Processes
topics.summary: Understand how S&OP differs from strategic, tactical, and operational planning; distinguish Demand Planning, Supply Planning, MPS, MRP, Production Scheduling, S&OE, and financial planning; and explain how the processes connect business objectives with manufacturing execution.

topics.title: Planning Horizons in Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)
topics.summary: Understand short-term, medium-term, and long-term planning; distinguish planning horizon, frequency, and bucket; and connect rolling S&OP plans with strategic direction and operational execution.

topics.title: Introduction to Financial Planning
topics.summary: Understand how financial planning connects with operational planning in S&OP, including revenue, costs, profitability, financial statements, working capital, cash flow, and the financial implications of manufacturing and inventory decisions.

topics.title: What is Supply Chain Management (SCM)?
topics.summary: Understand what a supply chain is, how Supply Chain Management coordinates suppliers, manufacturers, distributors, and customers, the material, information, and financial flows, supply chain objectives and trade-offs, and how S&OP supports end-to-end supply chain coordination.

topics.title: Supply Chain Components
topics.summary: Understand the major components of a supply chain, their individual responsibilities, how they interact, and how suppliers, procurement, manufacturing, inventory, logistics, distribution, customers, and supporting functions influence S&OP.

topics.title: Understanding Product Flow in Supply Chain Management
topics.summary: Understand the end-to-end physical movement of materials and products from suppliers to customers, the inbound, internal, and outbound stages, inventory transformation and availability, production bottlenecks, supply chain disruptions, and how product flow information supports S&OP decisions.

topics.title: KPI Analysis and Interpretation
topics.summary: Understand how to analyze and interpret S&OP KPIs, calculate and investigate performance variances and trends, identify relationships and trade-offs between demand, supply, inventory, and financial indicators, apply root cause analysis and segmentation, and translate validated findings into actionable management recommendations.

topics.title: Data Analytics for S&OP
topics.summary: Understand how to prepare and analyze S&OP data, apply descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics, investigate demand, supply, inventory, and supplier performance, use Excel, Power BI, SQL, and Python, and translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations.

topics.title: S&OP Reporting and Dashboard
topics.summary: Understand how S&OP reports and dashboards communicate business performance, monitor demand, supply, inventory, capacity, and financial KPIs, identify exceptions, validate and consolidate data, use Excel, Power BI, SQL, and Python for reporting, and translate findings into management decisions.

topics.title: Continuous Improvement
topics.summary: Understand how to improve S&OP through KPI monitoring, performance gap analysis, root cause investigation, PDCA, DMAIC, Kaizen, Lean, Six Sigma, measurable improvement initiatives, action ownership, effectiveness measurement, and sustainable process controls.
